programs.title: Code Black
programs.desc: Angel's Memorial descends into chaos when a plane crashes into the eighth floor. Noa has a car accident, and it is up to Mario to save her life. Willis admits to Rox that he needs her in his life, and the doctors gather in court to support Leanne for her custody hearing.

programs.title: Chicago Fire
programs.desc: When a fireman from Firehouse 51 is killed in a fire, the men who make up the remaining team of firemen struggle to deal with the aftermath of the tragedy while two of the prominent lieutenants want to blame each other for the the fireman's death.
